packs.title: Pink City, full colour.
packs.description: A suggested Jaipur escape for your campus crew. The organisers confirm travel, availability, the final itinerary and the full quote before booking.

days.title: Day 1
days.description: Jaipur Arrival → Hotel Check-in → Hawa Mahal → City Palace → Jantar Mantar → Johari Bazaar → Jaipur Night Market → Hotel Stay

days.title: Day 2
days.description: Hotel → Amer Fort → Panna Meena ka Kund → Jaigarh Fort → Jal Mahal → Nahargarh Fort (Sunset Viewpoint) → Jaipur Café Hopping → Hotel Stay

days.title: Day 3
days.description: Hotel → Albert Hall Museum → Patrika Gate → Birla Mandir → Local Shopping / Food Exploration → Departure

exclusions: Transport, meals, entry fees and activities unless explicitly included in the final quote

estimated_cost.note: Excludes travel to and from Jaipur.

packs.description: A suggested Darjeeling escape for your campus crew. The organisers confirm travel, availability, the final itinerary and the full quote before booking.

days.title: Day 1
days.description: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) / Siliguri → Scenic Drive to Darjeeling → Hotel Check-in → Darjeeling Mall Road → Chowrasta Square → Local Café Hopping → Night Market → Hotel Stay

days.title: Day 2
days.description: Hotel → Tiger Hill (Sunrise Viewpoint) → Batasia Loop → Ghoom Monastery → Himalayan Mountaineering Institute → Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park → Darjeeling Ropeway (if time permits) → Hotel Stay

days.title: Day 3
days.description: Hotel → Lamahatta Eco Park → Tinchuley Viewpoint → Takdah Tea Garden → Scenic Photography Stops → Return to Darjeeling → Bonfire / Group Dinner (if available) → Hotel Stay

days.title: Day 4
days.description: Hotel → Happy Valley Tea Estate → Japanese Peace Pagoda → Local Shopping / Souvenirs → Scenic Drive to Siliguri / NJP → Departure

exclusions: Transport, meals, entry fees and activities unless explicitly included in the final quote
packs.cancellation: Confirm cancellation and refund terms with the organisers before booking or paying.

estimated_cost.note: Includes shared accommodation, food, local sightseeing and NJP transfers; excludes train travel to NJP.

packs.title: Take the conversation to the mountains.
packs.description: A suggested 5-day, 4-night Gangtok and Pelling escape, with a Tsomgo Lake excursion subject to permits and road conditions. The organisers confirm availability, the itinerary and the final quote before booking.

days.title: Day 1
days.description: NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport → Drive to Gangtok → Check-in → MG Marg evening walk → Overnight in Gangtok

days.title: Day 2
days.description: Gangtok → Tsomgo Lake → Baba Mandir → Return to Gangtok. Excursion subject to permits, weather and road access; the organisers will arrange an alternative if unavailable.

days.title: Day 3
days.description: Gangtok → Scenic drive to Pelling → Check-in → Leisure evening → Overnight in Pelling

days.title: Day 4
days.description: Pelling → Pemayangtse Monastery → Rabdentse Ruins → Pelling Skywalk → Return to Pelling. Visits depend on opening hours, road access and available time.

days.title: Day 5
days.description: Pelling → Drive to NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport → Departure. Keep sufficient time for onward connections.

exclusions: Transport, meals, entry fees and activities unless explicitly included in the final quote
packs.cancellation: Confirm cancellation and refund terms with the organisers before booking or paying.

estimated_cost.note: Indicative planning estimate for twin-sharing accommodation, breakfast/dinner, local sightseeing and NJP/Bagdogra transfers. Excludes travel to/from NJP or Bagdogra, taxes, entry fees, personal expenses and optional Nathula visits. Inclusions and actual cost require organiser confirmation.

packs.title: Follow the green.
packs.description: A suggested Meghalaya escape for your campus crew. The organisers confirm travel, availability, the final itinerary and the full quote before booking.

days.title: Day 1
days.description: Guwahati → Umiam Lake (Barapani) → Shillong Peak Viewpoint → Don Bosco Centre for Indigenous Cultures → Police Bazaar

days.title: Day 2
days.description: Shillong → Mawkdok Dympep Valley Viewpoint → Photography Stops → Wei Sawdong Falls → Dainthlen Falls → Camping Stay

days.title: Day 3
days.description: Camping Stay → Dawki / Bangladesh Viewpoint → Mawlynnong Village (Asia’s Cleanest Village) → Riwai Single Living Root Bridge → Elephant Falls Hotel / Sohra Hotel

days.title: Day 4
days.description: Hotel → Trek to Nongriat Village → Double Decker Living Root Bridge → Rainbow Falls (if included in your trek plan) → Return to Hotel

days.title: Day 5
days.description: Hotel → Elephant Falls → Garden of Caves (Ka Bri Synrang) → Mawsmai Cave → Sohra (Cherrapunji)

days.title: Day 6
days.description: Sohra → Guwahati → Kamakhya Temple (if time permits) → Departure

exclusions: Transport, meals, entry fees and activities unless explicitly included in the final quote
packs.cancellation: Confirm cancellation and refund terms with the organisers before booking or paying.

estimated_cost.note: Confirm whether this range is per person or for the group, and what is included, with the organisers.
